item.summary: NBX has filed an application for a banking licence in Latvia for its wholly owned subsidiary, NBX Digital Asset Bank AS in Riga, according to a stock exchange notice reported by Kaupr on 17 November 2026. The application is for a specialised credit institution under Latvian law; it has been filed, not granted. Latvijas Banka will ask for more information before the application counts as complete, and the European Central Bank grants the licence on Latvijas Banka's recommendation. NBX says the planned digital bank would operate cross-border in Norway, Lithuania, Sweden, Finland, Poland and Germany, and that operations could start at the earliest by the end of 2027, with 2028 more likely.
